name: daily_stock_analysis
description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
one_liner: A free, automated tool that reads stock prices, news, and chart patterns for your watchlist every day and emails or messages you an AI-written buy/sell/hold summary across US, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Taiwanese markets.
buyer: An active retail investor who tracks 10-20 stocks across multiple markets and wants a daily digest instead of manually reading news and charts every morning.
business_use_cases: A retail trading newsletter operator runs it on a free GitHub Actions schedule to auto-generate daily stock commentary for a paid subscriber list.
A personal finance YouTuber/blogger uses its daily reports as raw material for a morning market-recap video or post, cutting research time.
An investment club or Discord trading community pipes its Telegram/Discord push output into their group chat as a shared daily briefing.

money_ideas.idea: Run it as the engine behind a paid daily stock-alert newsletter or Discord channel
Offer managed setup (watchlist, data sources, notification channels) for non-technical traders
White-label the dashboard for small RIAs or trading educators to hand to clients

steal_this: Deploy it on GitHub Actions for a curated 15-stock watchlist, pipe the daily push to a Telegram channel, and sell access to the channel this weekend.
